name: Hotel Bergland
beschreibung: The Hotel Bergland occupies a sunny hillside position just above the village centre at Sillian 93 in East Tyrol's Hochpustertal, close to the border with South Tyrol. This welcoming, family-managed traditional hotel features cosy alpine country-style guest rooms equipped with contemporary en-suite bathrooms, satellite TV, free Wi-Fi, and private balconies presenting unobstructed panoramic views of the Lienz and Sesto Dolomites and the Carnic Alps. Following active adventures outdoors, the on-site spa facility featuring a Finnish sauna and quiet room invites guests to unwind. In the dining room, a nutritious morning breakfast buffet packed with regional East Tyrolean delicacies is served, complemented by authentic dinners in the evening. The lower station of the Hochpustertal Sillian ski centre is only minutes away, with ski buses stopping nearby. In summer, the famed Drau Cycle Path and scenic high-altitude trails await.
kurzbeschreibung: Cosy traditional hotel at Sillian 93 in the Hochpustertal in East Tyrol with Dolomite views, sauna, and near the ski resort.
